product.olivetti-echos-26c.summary: The two-kilogram Echos the Japanese press listed among 1996 subnotebooks.
product.olivetti-echos-26c.history: In January 1996, Internet Magazine included the Echos 26C in a Japanese subnotebook roundup and listed it at ¥318,000.
product.olivetti-echos-26c.architecture: The pointing device was operated from the keyboard. A contemporary buyer recalls a trackball at the top right and a 100 MHz Intel DX4.
product.olivetti-echos-26c.verified: The press confirms the model, and the processor comes from an owner’s account. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-26c.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
